section: Perspectives in Education · Ch — Contemporary Educational Concerns
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: NEP 2020 recommends that by 2025, at least 50% of learners should have exposure to vocational education through school and higher education, integrating hands-on skill training (like carpentry, electrical work, or coding) alongside academics. This policy thrust is called:
explanation: Vocationalisation of education integrates practical, skill-based vocational training into mainstream schooling, addressing the traditional gap between academic education and employable skills — a major NEP 2020 thrust.
